name: Iron Pickaxe
Effect: +2 mining speed, mines stone and ore
Crafting Material: Iron Ingot x3, Wooden Handle x1
Description: A sturdy pickaxe with a forged iron head bound to a worn wooden handle. Basic but reliable for breaking rocks.

name: Steel Pickaxe
Effect: +4 mining speed, 10% chance to double ore drops
Crafting Material: Steel Ingot x3, Hardwood Handle x1
Description: A gleaming pickaxe forged from refined steel. Its hardened edge bites into stone with satisfying ease.

name: Gold Pickaxe
Effect: +3 mining speed, doubles all ore yields
Crafting Material: Gold Ingot x4, Iron Rod x1
Description: A luxurious pickaxe with a polished golden head. It glitters under torchlight, trading durability for extraordinary yield.

name: Mithril Pickaxe
Effect: +6 mining speed, 25% chance to find rare minerals
Crafting Material: Mithril Ingot x3, Enchanted Handle x1
Description: A pale blue pickaxe that hums faintly when near ore veins. Forged from the rarest surface metal.

name: Adamantine Pickaxe
Effect: +8 mining speed, ignores rock hardness, 5% chance to find gemstones
Crafting Material: Adamantine Bar x4, Dragon Bone Handle x1
Description: An impossibly dark pickaxe that absorbs light. Its edge never dulls and can crack the hardest known stone.

name: Copper Chisel
Effect: +1 precision mining, extracts gems intact
Crafting Material: Copper Ingot x2, Leather Wrap x1
Description: A slender copper tool with a fine point. Used by miners who seek to extract crystals without shattering them.

name: Mining Hammer
Effect: +3 mining power, breaks boulders in one strike
Crafting Material: Iron Ingot x4, Oak Handle x1
Description: A heavy iron hammer with a broad flat face. Designed for demolishing large rock formations rather than delicate extraction.

name: Prospector's Lens
Effect: Reveals hidden ore veins within 10 tiles
Crafting Material: Glass Lens x1, Copper Frame x1, Leather Strap x1
Description: A brass-framed magnifying lens on a leather cord. Allows the wearer to spot veins of ore through solid rock.

name: Drill Bit
Effect: +5 mining speed on metal ore, 20% faster extraction
Crafting Material: Steel Ingot x2, Iron Rod x1
Description: A spiraling steel bit designed for boring into mineral deposits. Best paired with a mechanical housing.

name: Blasting Powder Keg
Effect: Destroys a 5x5 area of rock, chance to scatter ores
Crafting Material: Gunpowder x8, Wooden Barrel x1, Fuse x1
Description: A small wooden barrel packed with explosive powder. One-time use that clears entire cave sections but risks scattering valuable ore.

name: Obsidian Pickaxe
Effect: +7 mining speed, critical hits shatter stone for bonus loot
Crafting Material: Obsidian Shard x5, Volcanic Handle x1
Description: A razor-sharp pickaxe carved from volcanic glass. Fragile but devastatingly effective against stone.

name: Woodcutter's Axe
Effect: +2 woodcutting speed, fells small trees
Crafting Material: Iron Axe Head x1, Wooden Handle x1
Description: A balanced axe with a wide blade. The workhorse tool of every lumberjack and survivalist.

name: Steel Axe
Effect: +4 woodcutting speed, 15% chance for bonus logs
Crafting Material: Steel Axe Head x1, Ash Handle x1
Description: A polished steel axe that cuts through timber like butter. Its edge holds for hundreds of swings.

name: Logger's Axe
Effect: +6 woodcutting speed, fells large trees, +10% rare wood chance
Crafting Material: Steel Bar x3, Ironwood Handle x1
Description: A double-bladed logging axe built for the densest forests. Requires significant strength to wield effectively.

name: Copper Sickle
Effect: +1 herb gathering speed, harvests 2x herbs
Crafting Material: Copper Blade x1, Wrapped Handle x1
Description: A small curved blade on a short handle. Perfect for snipping herbs and small plants at the base.

name: Silver sickle
Effect: +3 herb gathering, 20% chance to find rare plants
Crafting Material: Silver Blade x1, Enchanted Handle x1
Description: A gleaming sickle with a crescent blade. Faintly glows when near magical flora.

name: Reaper's Scythe
Effect: +5 gathering speed, harvests wide area, +15% rare material chance
Crafting Material: Dark Steel Blade x1, Bone Handle x1
Description: A tall, imposing scythe with a long curved blade. Cuts entire fields of crops or plants in sweeping arcs.

name: Forager's Basket
Effect: +20% carrying capacity for gathered materials
Crafting Material: Wicker x6, Leather Strap x2
Description: A woven wicker basket reinforced with leather straps. Light and spacious for carrying gathered herbs and berries.

name: Flint Knife
Effect: +1 skinning speed, clean animal hides
Crafting Material: Flint Blade x1, Bone Handle x1
Description: A crude but effective knife made from knapped flint lashed to a bone handle. Essential for early survival.

name: Skinning Knife
Effect: +3 skinning speed, +25% hide quality
Crafting Material: Steel Blade x1, Leather Wrapped Handle x1
Description: A curved, sharp blade designed specifically for removing hides without damaging them.

name: Lumber Saw
Effect: +4 woodcutting, produces planks directly from logs
Crafting Material: Steel Teeth x12, Wooden Frame x1
Description: A two-handled crosscut saw. Slower than an axe but produces usable lumber rather than raw logs.

name: Berry Picker
Effect: +2 berry gathering, +30% bonus yield, auto-sort berries
Crafting Material: Tin Bucket x1, Soft Cloth x2
Description: A small tin bucket with a wide rim. Designed to pluck berries without bruising them.

name: Root Digger
Effect: +3 root harvesting, unearths hidden tubers
Crafting Material: Iron Tines x3, Wooden Handle x1
Description: A three-pronged garden fork built for loosening soil and extracting deep-rooted plants intact.

name: Blacksmith's Hammer
Effect: +3 smithing quality, shapes metal items
Crafting Material: Iron Head x1, Oak Handle x1
Description: A heavy, balanced hammer with a flat face. Every blacksmith's most essential tool for shaping hot metal.

name: Forge Anvil
Effect: Required for metalworking, +5 crafting quality
Crafting Material: Iron Block x10, Stone Base x1
Description: A massive iron anvil with a flat top and horn. The backbone of any smithy, built to last generations.

name: Craftsman's Chisel
Effect: +2 precision crafting, detail work on metals and wood
Crafting Material: Steel Blade x1, Walnut Handle x1
Description: A fine-tipped chisel for detailed carving work. Steady hands required for best results.

name: Loom
Effect: Weaves cloth and fabric from raw fibers
Crafting Material: Hardwood Frame x4, Iron Rods x2, String x10
Description: A wooden frame loom with taut threads. Transforms raw wool and plant fibers into usable fabric.

name: Spinning Wheel
Effect: Spins raw fiber into thread and yarn
Crafting Material: Hardwood Planks x3, Iron Spindle x1, Thread x5
Description: A wooden wheel with a spindle mechanism. Converts raw wool, flax, or cotton into workable thread.

name: Sewing Needle
Effect: +1 tailoring precision, required for cloth armor
Crafting Material: Steel Wire x1
Description: A tiny, razor-sharp needle with a narrow eye. Small enough to lose in carpet, important enough to carry always.

name: Leatherworking Kit
Effect: +2 leather crafting quality, shapes leather armor and goods
Crafting Material: Steel Tools x3, Leather Case x1, Bone Needles x2
Description: A compact kit containing awls, edge bevelers, and needles for working leather into armor, bags, and accessories.

name: Enchanting Table
Effect: Enchants weapons and armor with magical properties
Crafting Material: Obsidian x8, Diamond x2, Enchanted Book x1
Description: A dark stone table inscribed with glowing runes. Channel magical energy through it to imbue equipment with power.

name: Alchemy Mortar
Effect: +2 potion brewing speed, grinds ingredients finely
Crafting Material: Granite Bowl x1, Granite Pestle x1
Description: A heavy stone mortar and pestle set. Essential for grinding herbs, minerals, and components for potions.

name: Jeweler's Tools
Effect: +3 gem crafting precision, sets gems into jewelry
Crafting Material: Fine Tweezers x1, Magnifying Lens x1, Silver Solder x3
Description: A delicate set of precision tools for cutting, shaping, and setting gemstones into rings, necklaces, and crowns.

name: Pottery Wheel
Effect: Shapes clay into vessels and containers
Crafting Material: Wooden Wheel x1, Clay Base x1, Iron Rod x1
Description: A spinning wooden wheel used to shape wet clay into bowls, vases, and jars. Mesmerizing to watch in action.

name: Woodworking Plane
Effect: +2 wood crafting precision, smooths and shapes wood
Crafting Material: Steel Blade x1, Wooden Body x1
Description: A hand plane that shaves thin curls of wood with each pass. Turns rough lumber into fine furniture.

name: Wooden Fishing Rod
Effect: +1 fishing, catches small fish
Crafting Material: Bamboo Pole x1, String x3, Hook x1
Description: A simple bamboo pole with a length of string and a bent metal hook. Gets the job done in a pinch.

name: Steel Fishing Rod
Effect: +3 fishing, catches medium fish, 10% rare catch chance
Crafting Material: Steel Rod x1, Silk Line x5, Barbed Hook x1
Description: A flexible steel rod with a smooth reel mechanism. Casts farther and handles larger fish with ease.

name: Deep Sea Rod
Effect: +5 fishing, catches ocean fish, 20% rare catch chance
Crafting Material: Titanium Rod x1, Braided Line x8, Heavy Hook x2
Description: A heavy-duty rod built for deep ocean fishing. Designed to withstand the pull of massive sea creatures.

name: Angler's Net
Effect: +2 fishing speed, catches multiple small fish at once
Crafting Material: Nylon Mesh x1, Bamboo Frame x2
Description: A wide, fine-mesh net on bamboo poles. Excellent for catching schools of small fish in shallow water.

name: Trawl Net
Effect: +4 fishing yield, drags along seabed for shellfish
Crafting Material: Iron Chain x2, Heavy Mesh x1, Weighted Rope x3
Description: A massive weighted net designed to be dragged along the ocean floor. Collects fish, crabs, and shellfish alike.

name: Fishing Spear
Effect: +2 spearfishing, one-shot catch for large fish
Crafting Material: Wooden Shaft x1, Iron Tines x3
Description: A wooden shaft tipped with three-pronged iron tines. Used for spearing fish in clear, shallow streams.

name: Crab Pot
Effect: Passive fishing, catches crabs and lobsters over time
Crafting Material: Wire Mesh x2, Bait x5
Description: A wire cage trap baited with scraps. Leave it overnight and return to find crustaceans crawling inside.

name: Chum Bucket
Effect: Attracts fish to fishing spot, +30% catch rate for 10 minutes
Crafting Material: Wooden Bucket x1, Fish Guts x5
Description: A pail of ground fish remains and blood. Smells terrible but attracts fish from far and wide.

name: Lure Box
Effect: +2 rare fish chance, holds 10 different lures
Crafting Material: Wooden Box x1, Steel Hinges x1, Felt Lining x1
Description: A small wooden box with dividers for organizing fishing lures. Each lure attracts different species.

name: Cooking Pot
Effect: +1 cooking quality, required for stews and soups
Crafting Material: Iron x4, Wooden Handle x1
Description: A round iron pot with a lid and handle. The foundation of every kitchen, capable of simmering soups and boiling water.

name: Frying Pan
Effect: +2 cooking speed, cooks meats and vegetables
Crafting Material: Cast Iron x3, Wooden Handle x1
Description: A flat-bottomed cast iron pan with a long handle. Perfect for searing steaks and sautéing vegetables over flame.

name: Stone Oven
Effect: +4 cooking quality, bakes bread and pastries
Crafting Material: Stone Blocks x12, Clay Mortar x4, Iron Grate x1
Description: A large domed oven built from stacked stone. Radiates even heat for baking breads, roasting meats, and firing ceramics.

name: Cast Iron Skillet
Effect: +3 cooking quality, retains heat for searing
Crafting Material: Cast Iron x5
Description: A heavy, well-seasoned cast iron skillet. Improves with use, developing a natural nonstick surface over years of cooking.

name: Chef's Knife
Effect: +2 food prep speed, +1 cooking quality
Crafting Material: Steel Blade x1, Wooden Handle x1
Description: A sharp, versatile kitchen knife with a broad blade. Essential for chopping, slicing, and dicing ingredients.

name: Rolling Pin
Effect: Required for dough preparation, +1 baking quality
Crafting Material: Hardwood x1
Description: A smooth, cylindrical wooden rolling pin. Used for flattening dough into even sheets for pastries and bread.

name: Spinning Ladle
Effect: +1 serving quality, stirs and serves liquids
Crafting Material: Wooden Bowl x1, Wooden Handle x1
Description: A deep wooden ladle for scooping soups, stews, and sauces. Simple but indispensable.

name: Mortar and Pestle Set
Effect: +2 spice grinding, unlocks advanced seasoning recipes
Crafting Material: Marble Bowl x1, Marble Pestle x1
Description: A polished marble mortar and pestle. Grinds spices and herbs into fine pastes for complex flavor profiles.

name: Rotisserie Spit
Effect: +3 meat cooking quality, slow roasts whole animals
Crafting Material: Iron Rod x1, Iron Brackets x2, Crank Handle x1
Description: A long iron spit with a hand crank. Mounts whole birds or roasts for even, golden-brown cooking over open flame.

name: Lantern
Effect: Illuminates 5-tile radius, reveals hidden paths
Crafting Material: Glass Panel x4, Iron Frame x1, Oil x2
Description: A glass-paneled lantern with a flickering oil flame inside. Casts warm light into dark caves and dungeons.

name: Compass
Effect: Shows cardinal directions, marks waypoints on map
Crafting Material: Magnetic Needle x1, Brass Casing x1, Glass Cover x1
Description: A small brass compass with a floating magnetic needle. Always points north, even underground.

name: Spyglass
Effect: +300% vision range, reveals distant landmarks
Crafting Material: Glass Lenses x3, Brass Tubes x2, Leather Grip x1
Description: A collapsible brass telescope with polished glass lenses. Extends to reveal distant towers, ships, and terrain features.

name: Shovel
Effect: +2 digging speed, uncovers buried items
Crafting Material: Iron Blade x1, Wooden Handle x1
Description: A sturdy iron shovel with a flat blade. Used for digging holes, burying items, and unearthing buried treasure.

name: Rope
Effect: Descend cliffs, tie items, build bridges
Crafting Material: Hemp Fiber x10
Description: A coil of strong hemp rope. Indispensable for climbing, securing cargo, and crossing gaps.

name: Torch
Effect: Illuminates 3-tile radius, scares away beasts
Crafting Material: Wooden Stick x1, Cloth Wrap x1, Oil x1
Description: A wooden stick wrapped in oil-soaked cloth. Burns bright for a short time and keeps shadows at bay.

name: Tent
Effect: Provides shelter, passive health regeneration while sleeping
Crafting Material: Canvas x4, Wooden Poles x4, Rope x2
Description: A canvas tent with wooden support poles. Provides shelter from rain and monsters during long wilderness treks.

name: Backpack
Effect: +50% inventory space, reduces weight burden
Crafting Material: Leather x4, Buckles x4, Cloth Lining x2
Description: A sturdy leather backpack with multiple compartments. Essential for carrying supplies on long journeys.

name: Lockpick Set
Effect: Opens locked doors and chests without keys
Crafting Material: Steel Wire x5, Tension Wrench x1
Description: A set of thin steel picks and tension tools. Used by rogues and adventurers to bypass locks.

name: Grappling Hook
Effect: Scale walls, cross chasms, pull objects
Crafting Material: Iron Hook x1, Chain x2, Rope x3
Description: A three-pronged iron hook attached to chain and rope. Throw it over walls or across gaps to create traversal points.
